Proposition
[Backward limits with fixed basepoint of a shrinker] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0184 ↗ lem:chow-iv-shrinker-canonical-form-characterization 1. ch30:30.32\group Type I Ancient Solutions

Let a complete bounded-curvature shrinking gradient Ricci soliton be in canonical form. For any fixed basepoint and $\tau _i\to \infty $, every Cheeger--Gromov convergent subsequence of its backward dilations has limit isometric to the original soliton, based at a critical point of its potential.
